label: Higher when the observer believes S2 is good, after choosing a2 (D2), and after reward (D1).
short_terms: belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u')
explanation: Beyond the strong timing profile (high at D1/D2, low at GO, declining through the episode), the raw reset gate of unit 9 tracks the ideal-observer belief that S2 is the good state: it falls with belief_lo (S1 good) at all phases, most steeply at D2. At D2 it is further raised when the just-made choice was a2 (observed at D2). At D1 it is higher after a rewarded previous trial and much lower after an unrewarded one. The free fit adds a separate D2 belief slope, the reached state at D2, a D1 reward x S2 interaction and a GO reward term (dev 0.72 vs 0.66 short). No future variables used; this trial reward and hidden good state add nothing beyond belief.

issues: The directional claims check out, with the D1 reward effect partly overlapping the belief term. On test the short form scores 0.641 beyond timing (dev 0.656). Fitted weights: belief_lo -0.026, D2*a2 +0.090, D1*prev_reward +0.058. Belief deciles show the steepest slope at D2 (residual range +0.157 to -0.182, against about +0.09 to -0.07 at D1 and GO). The reward step at D1 holds for every previous choice/state pair: r minus u is +0.12, +0.10, +0.10 and +0.06.

One large systematic error class remains. On misses the short form over-predicts D1 after 'a1 S1 u' by -0.146, the biggest error cell and a common trial type. Worst-fit windows are runs of unrewarded trials where the unit sits 0.3-0.4 below the prediction at D1 (e.g. t92-96, r0 actual 0.22-0.35 vs predicted 0.50-0.64). After 'a1 S1 u' the belief moves toward S2, so the model predicts a rise, but the unit is at its lowest. The label does not cover this.

Reward-history terms do not fix it: prev_reward + tv(reward,-2) + tv(reward,-3) scores 0.600, a two-unrewarded-trials term 0.610, and prev_reward at all phases 0.613. Adding D1*last_is('a1 S1 u') gives 0.646 test, a small gain that only partly closes the cell. On misses the worst cells become D1 after a2 S1 u at -0.080 and D2 after a1 S1 u at -0.081.

The gap to what observed cues can reach is large. The all-observed additive reference is 0.82 and the free fit only reaches 0.70 (a 5-term free fit I ran got 0.697), so the 3-term form leaves about 0.18 of the reachable variance unexplained. That is too much for 'explained'.

Belief shape: the decile residuals look like a step around belief 0.5 rather than a straight line in log-odds, but tanh(belief_lo) scores worse (0.623) than linear belief_lo, so the linear term is fine. Removing terms: belief alone 0.545, belief + D2*a2 0.598, so every term earns its place.
The label is broadly accurate. 'After reward (D1)' is right but does not say that the D1 dip after unrewarded a1->S1 is much larger than the belief and reward terms predict.
skeptic.revised_label: Higher when the observer favors S2, at D2 after choosing a2; lowest at D1 after unrewarded a1->S1.
skeptic.better_short_terms: belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u')

final_label: Higher when the observer favors S2, at D2 after choosing a2; lowest at D1 after unrewarded a1->S1.
